task: Find out which building is the tallest in the world and how tall it is, and write two sentences for a school report that say where the facts come from.

en.title: Cost: no web search
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
The researcher answers from what the model knows.

**What it teaches**

Without search a run is cheap, but the answer has no sources.
